abilities.name: Guard Stance
abilities.description: As a Free Action, your partner Digimon may enter a stance. Until the start of your next turn, the damage your Digimon deals is reduced by your Reliability rank, but their Miss Threshold increases by an additional amount equal to your Reliability rank as well.

abilities.name: Clean Technique
abilities.description: Guard Stance no longer reduces the damage your Digimon deals.

abilities.name: Exploit the Opening
abilities.description: When you use Guard Stance, all enemies within 3 spaces of your Digimon also have their Miss Threshold reduced by your Reliability rank. This lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Guarded Together
abilities.description: When you use Guard Stance, all allies within 3 spaces of your Digimon also gain a bonus to their Miss Threshold equal to your Reliability rank. This lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Optimal Angle
abilities.description: As a Free Action on your turn, spend 2 Hope. Choose one enemy within 4 spaces of your Digimon. Make a Zero Error check, DN 12. On a success, you identify the optimal attack angle: your Digimon's next attack against that enemy ignores half that enemy's Love-based Damage Reduction, rounded down.
